mapper.select: SELECT r.rental_id AS rentalId, r.equipment_id AS equipmentId, e.equipment_name AS equipmentName, u.user_name AS userName, r.rental_date AS rentalDate, r.return_date AS returnDate FROM RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON r.equipment_id = e.equipment_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND r.request_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY r.rental_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.rental_id AS rentalId, u.user_name AS applicant, e.equipment_name AS itemName, r.rental_date AS startDate, r.return_date AS dueDate FROM RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON r.equipment_id = e.equipment_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.request_status = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY r.rental_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON e.equipment_id = r.equipment_id SET r.request_status = 'APPROVED', e.status = 'RENTED', e.updated_at = NOW() WHERE r.rental_id = #{rentalId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.rental_id AS rentalId, u.user_name AS applicant, e.equipment_name AS itemName, r.return_date AS currentDue, r.requested_return_date AS requestDue, r.extend_reason AS reason FROM RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON r.equipment_id = e.equipment_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.extend_status = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY r.rental_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE RENTAL SET return_date = requested_return_date, extend_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE rental_id = #{rentalId}
